descriptionChirho: Qal participle used adjectivally or substantivally to denote a person who is poor, impoverished, or destitute, across all inflections (singular/plural) and with various prepositions, articles, and conjunctions.
Qal finite verbal form describing the state or process of being in want, lacking, or becoming impoverished.
Hitpael participle with pretensive force: one who makes himself appear poor or pretends to be impoverished, distinct from genuinely being poor.
